entries.09a57dbcec3adb40: The procedures from declaring goods to customs to obtaining permission when exporting or importing them. It also includes the procedures for determining and paying customs duties. Carrying out these procedures on behalf of others at their request is called "customs clearance services (tsukan gyomu)," and is handled by customs brokers licensed by the government.
